facets.F1_correctness: Tenant-scoped quota reads and writes now fail before Cedar evaluation when a non-platform principal targets another tenant.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 unit tests cover tenant-admin cross-tenant write denial, tenant-viewer cross-tenant read denial, and platform-operator cross-tenant read allowance.
facets.F3_maintainability: The guard is a small local helper in the Cedar quota adapter and reuses the existing WorkloadPrincipal and TenantId contracts.
facets.F4_compatibility: No public API, Buck target, generated artifact, Cargo manifest, workflow, or oya-ci.toml change is introduced.
facets.F5_security: Closes a cross-tenant authorization gap by enforcing tenant equality in adapter code and reserving cross-tenant access for the platform quota scope.
facets.F6_privacy: Prevents tenant principals from reading quota records for other tenants in this adapter path.
facets.F7_operability: Denied errors include principal workload and target tenant identifiers for local debugging without adding runtime dependencies.
facets.F8_performance: The guard is a constant-time string comparison and scope lookup before the existing Cedar authorizer call.
facets.F9_compliance: No hand-edited *.generated.json files and no new dependencies. The evidence record is append-only and non-generated.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of one Rust adapter file and this evidence file.
facets.F11_observability: The denied path produces a specific authorization error that can be surfaced by existing callers; no telemetry schema is changed.
facets.F13_migration: Keeps tenant isolation in a provider-neutral Rust adapter instead of relying on shell, CLI, or provider-specific behavior.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected a broader policy-engine rewrite because the measurable gap was local cross-tenant enforcement.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: The slice improves IAM/authz parity without touching shared hot files, root hub specs, generated faces, or workflows.

comparable_surfaces: AWS IAM condition-key guarded EKS quota operations
GCP IAM-scoped GKE tenant/project quota administration
CloudFormation or Deployment Manager tenant-scoped infrastructure control planes
hyperscaler_lens.improved_criterion: tenant/project/account isolation and IAM/authz policy for tenant quota records
hyperscaler_lens.merge_conflict_resistance: Single owned Rust adapter file plus one append-only evidence JSON file; no generated faces or shared policy/config files.
hyperscaler_lens.provider_neutrality: The implementation uses existing Rust domain and authz contracts and does not add cloud SDK, shell, Python, CLI, or provider dependencies.
